generic.Defined scope/population: All treaty sections in the renewal program with their ceded premium, exposure and loss records.
generic.In-scope period: Five to ten years of loss experience plus exposure as at the agreed snapshot date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accident or underwriting year, section, ceded premium, paid, outstanding and IBNR populated on every record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium extract total equals the general ledger written premium control total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each extract saved with the snapshot date and version number in the renewal data folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched or missing loss records logged with cause and correction before the pack is released.
generic.Test population: Every dataset in the submission pack plus the large-loss listing above attachment point.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Nil variance to the general ledger control total and one common as-at date across all datasets.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst investigates the break and refers unresolved items to the Reinsurance Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Datasets accepted when reconciled, restated on agreed factors and dated to the snapshot.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal submission data folder in the reinsurance administration system under the treaty reference.

steps.title: Extract ceded premium and exposure data from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the renewal extract in the enterprise data warehouse for every treaty section in the program
Apply the as-at snapshot date agreed with the Reinsurance Actuary to all queries
Export the result to Microsoft Excel keeping section, currency and period fields intact
Done when the premium and exposure extract is saved under the renewal reference
verify: Check the snapshot date shown on the extract header equals the agreed as-at date
Pass when every treaty section appears with a premium value or a documented nil

steps.title: Pull five to ten years of loss experience from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Query loss history by accident year and by underwriting year for each treaty section
Include paid, outstanding and IBNR components on every loss record pulled
Label each triangle with the basis used so accident and underwriting years are not mixed
Done when a labelled loss triangle exists for every treaty section
verify: Compare the earliest and latest years pulled against the agreed experience window
Pass when each section has a complete triangle with no missing development year

steps.title: Reconcile the ceded premium extract to the general ledger in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build a reconciliation tab comparing extract premium totals to the ledger written premium control total
Split any difference by section and currency to locate the source of the break
Record the explanation for each reconciling item on the same tab
Done when the reconciliation shows nil unexplained variance
verify: Recompute the control total from the ledger figure independently of the extract
Pass when the residual unexplained variance is zero

steps.title: Restate historical losses to current terms using agreed indexation factors in Excel
sop: Apply the trend, indexation and on-level factors agreed for this renewal to each loss year
Show gross and restated figures side by side so the adjustment is visible
Record the factor source and effective date on the restatement tab
Done when every loss year carries a restated value and its factor
verify: Recalculate one restated year by hand against the stated factor
Pass when the manual recalculation equals the workbook value

steps.title: Build the large-loss listing above attachment point in Microsoft Excel
sop: List every loss above the attachment point with date of loss, cause and section
Show paid, outstanding and IBNR split for each listed loss
Cross-check the listing count against the claims extract from the administration system
Done when the listing is complete for all years in the experience window
verify: Compare the listed large-loss total to the aggregate loss triangle for the same years
Pass when the large-loss total ties into the triangle without unexplained difference

steps.title: Produce the exposure profile banding from the warehouse snapshot
sop: Band sums insured and limits into the profile bands requested by the market
Use the same as-at snapshot date applied to the premium and loss extracts
State policy counts and aggregate limit per band on the profile
Done when the exposure profile is produced for every section
verify: Sum the banded aggregate limit and compare to the warehouse total exposure
Pass when banded totals equal the source exposure total

steps.title: Assemble and version the dataset pack for the submission
sop: Combine the premium, loss, large-loss and exposure outputs into one versioned workbook
Stamp every tab with the as-at date and the pack version number
Store the pack in the renewal folder under the treaty reference
Done when the versioned pack is stored and the version is logged
verify: Open each tab and confirm the same as-at date appears on all of them
Pass when all datasets carry one identical snapshot date

generic.Defined scope/population: Every broker and reinsurer template variant required for this renewal submission.
generic.In-scope period: The submission as-at date and the treaty period being placed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every mapped template field carries a value or an explicit nil, with no placeholder text.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium, loss and exposure totals on each template agree to the source data pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each workbook tab version-stamped with the as-at date and submission version number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Fields the template cannot accommodate logged with the agreed treatment and market note.
generic.Test population: All released template files including each reinsurer bespoke variant.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No live external link, no formula error and no total differing from the source pack.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst raises mapping queries to the Treaty Specialist before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Template accepted when totals tie, cells are protected and values replace formulas.
generic.Evidence location: Submission folder on Microsoft 365 SharePoint under the treaty reference and version.

steps.title: Map internal data fields into the broker standard template in Microsoft Excel
sop: Open the broker exposure and loss template and map each internal field to its template column
Copy values across without altering, rounding or re-basing any figure
Record the field mapping on a hidden mapping tab for audit
Done when every required broker template column is populated
verify: Spot-check five mapped fields back to the source data pack
Pass when each checked value equals the source value exactly

steps.title: Produce each reinsurer bespoke template variant in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build a separate variant for each market requiring bespoke currency, banding or section split
Convert currency using the single FX rate agreed for the submission
Name each file with the reinsurer, treaty reference and version
Done when a variant exists for every market that requires one
verify: List the bespoke requirements against the variants produced
Pass when no requested variant is missing from the release set

steps.title: Version-stamp every workbook tab with the as-at date and version
sop: Add the as-at date and submission version to the header of each tab
Apply the same version number across all files in the release set
Update the file properties to match the stamped version
Done when all tabs and files carry the same version stamp
verify: Open each file and read the stamp on the first and last tab
Pass when a single consistent version and date appears everywhere

steps.title: Convert working and formula tabs to values and protect cells
sop: Paste formula ranges as values so no calculation remains live in the released file
Remove or clear internal working tabs not intended for the market
Apply sheet protection to prevent accidental edit after release
Done when the release copy contains values only and is protected
verify: Search the workbook for remaining formulas and external links
Pass when no live external link or unresolved formula error remains

steps.title: Check formatted template totals against the source data pack
sop: Compare premium, loss and exposure totals on each template to the source pack totals
Investigate and correct any difference caused by banding or rounding
Record the tie-out on the check tab of the release file
Done when every template total agrees to the source pack
verify: Recompute one template total independently from the source pack
Pass when the recomputed total equals the template total

steps.title: File the formatted release set on Microsoft 365 SharePoint
sop: Upload the approved release set to the submission folder under the treaty reference
Mark the version as the controlling release copy for this submission
Remove or supersede earlier drafts in the same folder
Done when only the controlling version is visible as current
verify: Open the folder and list the files marked current
Pass when only the released version is marked current

generic.Defined scope/population: Every appointed broker and lead reinsurer on the approved target market distribution list.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release accepted when the approved final version reached every listed market with a covering note.

steps.title: Confirm the broker distribution list against the approved target market list
sop: Obtain the broker distribution list and compare it line by line to the approved target market list
Remove any market not approved and add any approved market that is absent
Confirm the corrected list in writing with the broker before release
Done when the broker list matches the approved list exactly
verify: Count and compare entries on both lists
Pass when no market appears on one list and not the other

steps.title: Withdraw any earlier draft already circulated to the market

Issue a withdrawal note instructing recipients to disregard the earlier draft
Remove superseded drafts from the platform and the shared placement folder
Done when no superseded draft remains available to any market
verify: List documents visible to markets on Reinsurer Exchange
Pass when only the approved final version is visible

steps.title: Prepare the covering note stating quote-by date and response format
sop: State the structure sought, the quote-by date and the required response format in the note
State the contact point for market questions and the Q and A process
Have the Reinsurance Manager review the note before release
Done when the reviewed covering note is ready to attach
verify: Read the note against the renewal timetable dates
Pass when the stated quote-by date matches the timetable

steps.title: Release the submission on Reinsurer Exchange on the market date
sop: Release the approved final pack on the market date set in the renewal timetable
Attach the covering note to the release so every market receives it
Release to all listed markets on identical terms and content
Done when the pack is released to every market on the approved list
verify: Check the platform release timestamp against the timetable market date
Pass when release occurred on the scheduled market date

steps.title: Send the submission by email to markets not on the platform
sop: Send the identical pack and covering note by Microsoft Teams or email to off-platform markets
Use the approved contact address held for each market entity
Request a read or delivery confirmation on each send
Done when every off-platform market has been sent the pack
verify: Check for bounce or non-delivery notices on each send
Pass when no send remains undelivered without a resend

steps.title: Record date, time and recipient of every transmission in the placement file
sop: Log each transmission with market entity, channel, date, time and version sent
Attach the platform receipt or email evidence against each log line
File the completed transmission log in the document management repository
Done when the log covers every market on the approved list
verify: Reconcile the transmission log count to the approved distribution list count
Pass when a transmission record exists for every listed market

generic.Defined scope/population: All loss statistics, triangles and burning-cost exhibits included in the renewal submission.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trend, development and on-level factors stated with source against every exhibit.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loss triangles reconcile to the reserving system as-at position for the same years.

steps.title: Reconcile loss triangles to the reserving system in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Load the submission triangles into the actuarial modeling platform for the same as-at date
Compare paid, outstanding and incurred by year to the reserving system position
Investigate and explain any difference before proceeding
Done when triangles agree to the reserving system for every year
verify: Recompute the incurred total from the reserving extract
Pass when the triangle incurred total equals the reserving system total

steps.title: Confirm trend, development and on-level factors applied to the statistics
sop: Review each factor applied to the loss statistics against its documented derivation
Confirm the factors used are the current agreed set for this renewal
Record the factor set and its source on the exhibit in Microsoft Excel
Done when every applied factor is confirmed and sourced
verify: Recalculate one restated loss year using the stated factor
Pass when the recalculated value equals the exhibit value

steps.title: Obtain peer review signature on the burning-cost exhibit
sop: Issue the burning-cost exhibit to the actuarial peer reviewer with the factor documentation
Address every peer review comment before the exhibit leaves the actuarial team
Record the peer reviewer name, date and version reviewed on the exhibit
Done when the peer review is signed on the released version
verify: Match the peer review record version to the version being released
Pass when a signed peer review record exists for the released version

steps.title: Document data limitations and gaps in the sign-off note
sop: List each known limitation in the loss history and its effect on the statistics
State how each limitation was treated in the exhibit
Include the limitations list in the sign-off note issued with the pack
Done when all known limitations are documented in the note
verify: Compare the limitations list to the data validation exception log
Pass when every open data exception appears in the sign-off note

steps.title: Confirm the submission exhibits match the signed-off statistics
sop: Compare the loss figures in the submission pack to the signed-off actuarial exhibit
Correct any figure in the pack that differs from the signed exhibit
Confirm the pack references the same exhibit version
Done when pack and exhibit carry identical figures and version
verify: Spot-check three loss years across pack and exhibit
Pass when all checked figures agree

steps.title: File the sign-off record in the document management repository
sop: Store the signed exhibit, peer review record and sign-off note as one set
Index the set by treaty reference, underwriting year and exhibit version
Link the sign-off record to the submission pack record
Done when the sign-off set is filed and retrievable
verify: Retrieve the sign-off record by treaty reference
Pass when name, date and exhibit version are all present on retrieval

generic.Defined scope/population: All modelled peril regions in the current exposure snapshot for the program being placed.
generic.In-scope period: The exposure snapshot date agreed for the renewal submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Model version, event set, demand surge and secondary uncertainty settings stated on every run.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled exposure total reconciles to the exposure profile used in the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model run outputs saved with run identifier, model version and run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmodelled or uncoded exposure quantified as a percentage and disclosed in the summary.
generic.Test population: Every return period result presented to the market for each modelled peril region.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No return-period figure shown without its model version and assumption note.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary reruns the model or annotates the result before it is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Summary accepted when gross and net results, settings and unmodelled share are all shown.
generic.Evidence location: Catastrophe model output folder linked to the submission pack in the renewal file.

steps.title: Load the current exposure snapshot into Moodys RMS
sop: Import the agreed exposure snapshot into Moodys RMS for each modelled peril region
Check geocoding resolution and correct unresolved locations where possible
Record the exposure total loaded against the source exposure profile
Done when the snapshot is loaded for every modelled peril region
verify: Compare loaded exposure total to the submission exposure profile total
Pass when the loaded total agrees to the exposure profile

steps.title: Run the catastrophe model for each modelled peril region
sop: Run the model on the loaded snapshot using the agreed event set for each peril region
Apply the agreed demand surge and secondary uncertainty settings consistently
Save each run with a unique run identifier and date
Done when a completed run exists for every modelled peril region
verify: List the completed runs against the modelled peril region list
Pass when no modelled peril region is missing a run

steps.title: Produce OEP and AEP losses at the requested return periods
sop: Extract OEP and AEP losses at every return period requested by the market
Tabulate the results per peril region in Microsoft Excel
Label each figure with its run identifier
Done when all requested return periods are tabulated
verify: Check the return period list requested against the table produced
Pass when every requested return period is present

steps.title: Show gross and net-of-existing-program results side by side
sop: Apply the existing program structure in the actuarial modeling platform to derive net results
Present gross and net figures in adjacent columns for each return period
State the program structure applied to derive the net position
Done when gross and net results are shown for every return period
verify: Recompute one net figure from the gross figure and the applied structure
Pass when the recomputed net figure matches the table

steps.title: Record model version, event set and settings on the output
sop: State model version, event set, demand surge and secondary uncertainty on the summary sheet
Note any deviation from the standard settings and the reason
Attach the run log to the summary for traceability
Done when settings are stated on every output page
verify: Read each output page for the settings block
Pass when no return-period result appears without its assumption note

steps.title: Disclose unmodelled and uncoded exposure in the summary
sop: Calculate the percentage of exposure that is unmodelled or uncoded in the snapshot
State the percentage and the affected classes in the summary in Microsoft Excel
Explain how the unmodelled share should be read alongside the results
Done when the unmodelled share is disclosed on the summary
verify: Recompute the unmodelled percentage from the exposure snapshot
Pass when the recomputed percentage equals the disclosed figure

steps.title: Attach the exposure summary to the submission pack
sop: Insert the finalised cat summary into the submission pack under the modelling section
Confirm the pack version references the correct model run identifier
Store the underlying run outputs with the pack in the renewal folder
Done when the summary is attached and its run outputs are stored
verify: Open the pack and confirm the summary and run identifier are present
Pass when the summary in the pack matches the stored run output

generic.Defined scope/population: The cover note, portfolio commentary, large-loss narrative and structure charts for this renewal.
generic.In-scope period: The period since the last renewal plus the treaty period being sought.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Structure sought, layers, limits, attachment points and inception date all stated in the note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Narrative figures for premium, rate change and large losses agree to the data pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Narrative documents versioned and dated in the document management repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Statements that cannot be evidenced removed or qualified before issue.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Cover note, portfolio commentary, large-loss narrative and structure chart all present.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist refers contested statements to the Reinsurance Manager for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Narrative accepted when reviewed by the Reinsurance Manager and consistent with the data pack.
generic.Evidence location: Submission narrative folder on Microsoft 365 SharePoint under the treaty reference.

steps.title: Draft the cover note stating the structure sought
sop: State the treaty type, layers, limits, attachment points and inception date sought
State the retention and any co-reinsurance intended
Draft in the approved cover note template on Microsoft 365 SharePoint
Done when the cover note states the full structure sought
verify: Compare the stated structure to the approved renewal strategy
Pass when the note matches the approved target structure

steps.title: Summarise portfolio changes since the last renewal
sop: Describe appetite, mix, rate change and new products since the expiring placement
Quantify the movement using figures taken from the submission data pack
Reference the supporting exhibit for each figure quoted
Done when portfolio change commentary is drafted with sourced figures
verify: Trace two quoted figures back to the data pack
Pass when both figures agree to the pack

steps.title: Describe underwriting and claims-handling changes affecting ceded experience
sop: Set out underwriting guideline and pricing changes made during the period
Set out claims handling, reserving or settlement practice changes
State the expected effect of each change on the ceded experience
Done when both underwriting and claims changes are described
verify: Check each described change against the source documentation held
Pass when every described change has supporting documentation

steps.title: List material large losses with a cause narrative
sop: Take the large-loss listing from the submission data pack for the period
Add a short cause narrative and current status for each material loss
Note any remedial action taken following each loss
Done when every material large loss carries a narrative
verify: Compare the narrative list to the large-loss listing in the data pack
Pass when no material loss in the pack is absent from the narrative

steps.title: Attach current and target program structure charts
sop: Produce the expiring program chart showing layers, limits and retention
Produce the target renewal structure chart on the same basis
Store both charts with the narrative in the document management repository
Done when both charts are attached to the narrative package
verify: Compare chart figures to the cover note structure statement
Pass when chart and cover note state the same structure

steps.title: Obtain Reinsurance Manager review of the narrative package
sop: Review the cover note, commentary, loss narrative and charts as one package
Challenge any statement not supported by the data pack
Record review comments and confirm resolution before release
Done when the reviewed package is approved for inclusion
verify: Check the package contents list against the required components
Pass when all four components are present and reviewed

generic.Defined scope/population: The full submission pack staged on the placing platform under the risk or UMR reference.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk reference, inception date, period and currency populated on the platform record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of attachments on the platform equals the count in the approved submission pack.

steps.title: Create the risk record on Reinsurer Exchange under the correct reference
sop: Create the risk on the placing platform using the allocated risk or UMR reference
Enter inception date, expiry date, period basis and settlement currency
Select the correct treaty type and class of business
Done when the risk record exists with header details entered
verify: Compare the platform header fields to the submission pack cover sheet
Pass when reference, period and currency match the pack

steps.title: Upload the full submission pack to the platform
sop: Upload every document in the approved submission pack to the risk record
Name each attachment so its content is identifiable without opening it
Confirm the upload count against the pack contents list
Done when every pack document is attached to the risk
verify: Count attachments on the platform against the pack contents list
Pass when the counts are equal

steps.title: Open every uploaded attachment to confirm it is readable
sop: Open each uploaded file from the platform after upload completes
Confirm no file is corrupted, truncated or password-protected
Replace any file that fails to open and re-check it
Done when every attachment opens cleanly from the platform
verify: Re-open a sample of attachments after any replacement
Pass when no attachment fails to open

steps.title: Set market visibility to the approved panel only
sop: Set platform permissions so only approved panel markets can view the risk
Remove any default or broad visibility setting applied on creation
Cross-check the permitted viewer list to the approved panel list
Done when only approved panel markets have view access
verify: List the markets with access on the platform
Pass when no market outside the approved panel has access

steps.title: Run the market-facing preview of the staged risk
sop: Open the market-facing preview and review the risk exactly as a market sees it
Check header details, attachment list and document ordering in the preview
Correct any presentation defect before release
Done when the preview renders correctly with no defect
verify: Compare the preview content to the approved submission pack
Pass when the preview shows the approved pack in full

steps.title: Cross-load the pack to the Broker and Agent Portal where required
sop: Load the same approved pack to the Broker and Agent Portal where the broker requires it
Use the identical version and reference used on Reinsurer Exchange
Confirm the broker can retrieve the pack from the portal
Done when the pack is staged on both platforms as required
verify: Compare the version staged on each platform
Pass when both platforms carry the same pack version

steps.title: Hand the staged risk to the Treaty Specialist for release
sop: Review the staged risk record and confirm it is ready for market release
Confirm the staging evidence is stored in the document management repository
Record the staging completion date against the renewal timetable
Done when the risk is confirmed staged and ready to send
verify: Check the staging record against the timetable release date
Pass when staging is complete before the scheduled release date

steps.title: Build the placement tracker in Microsoft Excel from the distribution list
sop: Create one tracker row per market on the approved distribution list

Set the acknowledgement deadline from the renewal timetable on the tracker

steps.title: Log receipt confirmations from Reinsurer Exchange and email

steps.title: Chase markets with no acknowledgement within the turnaround window

Record the chase date and channel on the tracker row
Done when every silent market has been chased and dated

steps.title: Record initial indications, questions and declinature reasons
sop: Record each market initial indication as quoted, without interpretation

Flag indications that deviate from the requested structure
Done when each responding market has its feedback recorded

steps.title: Maintain a single controlled market question and answer log
sop: Add every market question to one controlled question and answer log
Issue each answer to all markets so no market holds different information
Version the log each time it is reissued to the market
Done when all questions are answered from the single controlled log

steps.title: Report placement tracker status to the Reinsurance Manager

verify: Check the report date against the agreed reporting frequency

Investigate whether each failure is a genuine value or a data defect

sop: Compare ceded figures in the pack to the reinsurance administration system position

Record each explanation against the reconciling line

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Playbook milestones align to the dates actually achieved in this renewal.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Playbook version incremented with a dated change log entry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lessons not carried into the playbook logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All playbook sections affected by lessons from this renewal.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Playbook version incremented with a change log entry for this renewal.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty Specialist refers contested playbook changes to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Playbook accepted when the placement team is notified of the changes made.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal playbook on Confluence with the change log stored on Microsoft 365 SharePoint.

steps.title: Update timetable milestones from the dates actually achieved
sop: Compare planned milestones to the dates actually achieved this renewal
Adjust the playbook timetable where the plan was consistently unachievable
Record the reason for each timetable change
Done when the timetable reflects realistic milestones
verify: Compare updated milestones to the actual milestone data
Pass when each updated milestone is supported by the actual data

steps.title: Update the submission data specification
sop: Add any new data field markets requested during this renewal
Remove fields that markets did not use
Record the source request behind each change
Done when the data specification is updated
verify: Compare the specification changes to the market question log
Pass when every added field traces to a market request

steps.title: Update approved market and security screening steps
sop: Update the security screening steps to current requirements
Reflect any new sanctions or rating check introduced this cycle
Record the change against the playbook section
Done when the screening steps are current
verify: Compare the playbook steps to the screening actually performed
Pass when the playbook matches current practice

steps.title: Update the wording checklist with friction clauses
sop: Add clauses that caused negotiation friction to the wording checklist
State the position to take on each in the next renewal
Link each entry to the dispute or comment that prompted it
Done when the wording checklist is updated
verify: Compare the checklist additions to the wording dispute log
Pass when every dispute clause appears on the checklist

steps.title: Version the playbook and write the change log entry
sop: Increment the playbook version on Confluence
Write a change log entry describing every change made for this renewal
Store the change log with the playbook on Microsoft 365 SharePoint
Done when the version and change log are updated
verify: Compare the change log entries to the sections changed
Pass when every change is described in the log

steps.title: Notify the placement team of the playbook changes
sop: Notify the placement team of the new playbook version and its changes
Confirm the team will work to the updated version next cycle
Record the notification in the document management repository
Done when the team is notified and the notice is filed
verify: Check the notification references the incremented version
Pass when the version and change log entry both exist for this renewal

generic.Defined scope/population: All renewal program documentation carrying target terms that must become as-placed terms.
generic.In-scope period: The placed treaty period as executed at this renewal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: As-placed structure, panel, signed lines and final ceded premium recorded throughout.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented ceded premium equals the final signed amounts in the treaty register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reissued documentation versioned and dated with prior drafts superseded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents still showing firm order estimates logged and corrected before reissue.
generic.Test population: Every renewal program document held for this treaty and underwriting year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No superseded draft of the program documentation left marked as current.
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst escalates unreconciled figures to the Treaty Specialist before reissue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documentation accepted when cross-checked against executed slips and the treaty register.
generic.Evidence location: Program documentation on Microsoft 365 SharePoint linked to the treaty repository record.

steps.title: Replace target terms with as-placed terms throughout
sop: Work through each document replacing target terms with as-placed terms
Take as-placed terms from the executed slips
Mark each replacement so the change is traceable
Done when no target term remains in the documentation
verify: Search the documentation for target-term language
Pass when no target term remains

steps.title: Update the structure chart, panel list and signed lines
sop: Update the structure chart to the final placed position
Update the panel list and signed lines from the signing schedule
Confirm the chart placed percentages match the schedule
Done when chart, panel and lines are updated
verify: Compare updated lines to the signing schedule
Pass when every line matches the schedule

steps.title: Update ceded premium figures to final signed amounts
sop: Replace firm order estimates with final signed ceded premium amounts
Take the figures from the reinsurance administration system treaty record
Show the premium by layer and in total
Done when all premium figures are final signed amounts
verify: Sum the layer premiums and compare to the treaty register total
Pass when the documented total equals the register total

steps.title: Cross-check documentation against slips and the treaty register
sop: Compare every documented term to the executed slips and the treaty register
Correct any figure or term that does not agree
Record the cross-check on the documentation file
Done when the cross-check is complete
verify: Recheck corrected items against both sources
Pass when no documented item differs from the slips or the register

steps.title: Reissue the documentation as the controlling version
sop: Version and reissue the updated documentation on Microsoft 365 SharePoint
Mark the reissued version as controlling
Link it from the treaty repository record
Done when the controlling version is reissued and linked
verify: Open the treaty repository link
Pass when it resolves to the reissued controlling version

steps.title: Supersede prior drafts of the program documentation
sop: Identify prior drafts still held in the live area
Mark each as superseded so it is not retrievable as current
Record the supersession completion against the treaty record
Done when only the reissued version is current
verify: Filter the documentation folder for versions marked current
Pass when no superseded draft remains marked current
